reason: D17 proves Bash5.3 rejects bundled dirs flags. Original34 remain unchanged, including unintended -lp snapshot diagnostics. Four NEW native-only questions recover topology with separate -l -p flags; no original/native/virtual rescore or retry.

cases.purpose: -n topology and output/no-output, separate display flag order and -- behavior
cases.source:
pushd -n a; pushd -n b; pushd -n c; printf 'before
'; dirs -l -p; pushd -n; printf 'swap=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pushd -n +1; printf 'rotate=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pushd -n -0; printf 'last=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; dirs -p -v; dirs -v -p; dirs -- +1; dirs +1 +2; printf 'selectors=%s
' $?

cases.purpose: Failure state at exact snapshots: pop vs rotation vs swap, no guessed transaction
cases.source:
pushd -n "$ROOT/a"; pushd -n "$ROOT/absent"; popd; printf 'pop=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pushd +1; printf 'rotate=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; dirs -c; pushd -n "$ROOT/absent"; pushd; printf 'swap=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pwd; dirs -c; pushd "$ROOT/absent"; printf 'direct=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p

cases.purpose: Readonly and closed-output state snapshots with no protection weakening
cases.source:
( readonly PWD; pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'readonlyPWD=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD" ); ( readonly OLDPWD; pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'readonlyOLD=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD" ); pushd "$ROOT/a" 1>&-; printf 'closedPush=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; popd 1>&-; printf 'closedPop=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p
